purpose: Issue #100 bullets 1+2+3 — standalone llama-server, unified bin/llama router (serve subcommand), GPU-only (-ngl 99). Confirm both serving binaries reach /health 200 and serve /completion successfully on Pascal P5200 sm_61.

request.prompt: In one sentence: what is the capital of France?

runs.label: unified-router-serve
runs.notes: Router shim loads libllama-server-impl.so via ldconfig; matches standalone throughput within sampling noise.

regression_band.note: Both 25.84 (standalone) and 25.82 (router) are within ±3% of the baseline. No regression vs the bench-gemma4-12b-qat-pascal-baseline.json measurement (25.54 t/s @ llama-bench tg128).
regression_band.cross_harness_note: Server-endpoint predicted_per_second (25.84/25.82, /completion) and llama-bench tg128 baseline (25.54) are different harnesses, so the +1.2% agreement strengthens the no-regression claim rather than weakens it (server path adds no measurable overhead over raw llama-bench).

content_note: Raw /completion (no chat template) on a non-templated prompt returns degenerate repetition ('What is the capital of France?' looped). This is expected behavior for raw-text continuation and does NOT indicate model failure — the model produces 40 valid tokens, throughput matches baseline, /health is green. Use /v1/chat/completions for templated requests (see bench-gemma4-12b-qat-mtp-pascal.json for templated greedy decode bench).
